final_message:
I drafted a first-lien-favorable First Lien/Second Lien Intercreditor Agreement (Articles I–X, signature and acknowledgment pages, and an Exhibit A joinder form), preceded by a closing issues memo to the partner, all in one Word file. The file passes the docx validator and reads back cleanly; it holds 180 days, all First Lien Obligations + $30MM, no cash adequate protection and broad voting, with conflicts flagged in shaded drafting notes and the memo, including the 91-day maturity date being wrong (it should be January 14, 2032, not July 16, 2031).

Files in /workspace/output:
- /workspace/output/intercreditor-agreement.docx

failed.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies revolver and term loan priority/pari passu question
failed.reasoning: Draft does not flag whether the $55M revolver has super-priority over or is pari passu with the $310M term loan; waterfall just defers to First Lien Documents order.

failed.title: ISSUE_004: Flags risk of automatic release enabling uptier/Serta-style transactions
failed.reasoning: No drafting note or memo entry flags that the automatic release could enable Serta-style/uptier/non-pro-rata transactions.

failed.title: ISSUE_004: Considers anti-Serta protections for automatic release
failed.reasoning: No anti-uptier protections (non-affiliate sale, ratable benefit) or Serta/Boardriders reference in the release provision; only a proceeds-applied condition for enforcement releases.

failed.title: ISSUE_006: Flags enforceability risk of complete adequate protection cash payment waiver
failed.reasoning: Adequate protection notes do not flag enforceability risk of the complete cash adequate protection waiver (no 361/363(e)/364 or Ion Media reference in that context; Ion Media is cited only on plan voting).

failed.title: ISSUE_006: Recommends savings clause or limitation rather than complete waiver
failed.reasoning: Section 6.04 is a flat prohibition on cash adequate protection with no savings clause or softening; the savings language in 6.10(c) addresses plan voting only.

failed.title: ISSUE_010: Notes second lien does not include hedging/cash management
failed.reasoning: The draft and notes do not acknowledge that the Second Lien Credit Agreement excludes hedging/cash management from Second Lien Obligations; the asymmetry noted concerns the 2L CA's First Lien Obligations definition.
